claims.claim_text: President Biden frequently identifies unity against hatred, racism, bigotry and violence as a core U.S. value.
Support for Americans of every background to unite against hatred, racism, bigotry and violence.
President Biden and Vice President Harris are credited with historically significant action against hatred by the time of the 2024 platform.
President Biden signed the Emmett Till Anti-Lynching Act, making lynching a federal crime.
President Biden hosted the "United We Stand Summit", elevating efforts against hatred to the highest U.S. government levels.
President Biden signed the COVID-19 Hate Crimes Act after Asian American, Native Hawaiian and Pacific Islander people faced a wave of hate during the pandemic.
President Biden sought increased funding to improve hate-crime prevention, reporting and prosecution.
By 2024, Democrats secured the largest funding increase in history for nonprofit security, including houses of worship.
